title: fix(app-shell): the Studio form designer lays out the form view the app opens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJGR4cWvN9AYGobHGzbeeuD)_

Fixes #30057

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 数据 → 表单 的设计器现在编辑的是应用新建/编辑弹窗真正打开的那个表单视图（问 `selectRecordFormView` 要答案）：对象没有表单视图时照旧编辑字段分组；有默认表单视图时，拖动字段、增删改分区都写进该视图的草稿，随包发布生效；只读基础包则写进配对的 `.custom` 定制包，作为声明的覆盖。新建和编辑用不同视图时，工具栏多一个 新建/编辑 切换；预览也按同一个视图排版。
- **为什么改**：对象有默认表单视图时，设计器原来改的是对象上的 `fieldGroups`，用户根本看不到这份布局，作者发布后毫无效果，也没有任何提示，属于静默丢工作。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 Studio 设计器和它的预览，应用端的表单渲染、元数据形状、服务端都不变，没有新键；无表单视图的对象行为与之前一致（有对照测试）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/useFormViewDraft.ts`（`formLayoutChoiceOf` 调用解析器、草稿读写与定制包覆盖），`formViewSections.ts`（`writeFormSectionLayout` 怎样保留字段条目上的 `required` 等原有键）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/formViewSections-30057.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件、14 条全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **Which layout the Form tab edits.** `formLayoutChoiceOf(objectDef, flow)` (new, `useFormViewDraft.ts`) calls `selectRecordFormView` for the shown flow and once each for create and edit, over the shell's merged objects (`useMetadata().objects`, the world the app's dialogs read). It never restates the resolver's rule; a test with a stubbed resolver pins that its answer comes straight back.
  1. No form view: unchanged. The designer edits the object's `fieldGroups`.
  2. A default form view: the designer shows that view's sections and writes them to the view item's draft (`view:OBJECT.KEY`) through the same draft door every Studio buffer uses (`readDraftForSave` pin, `useDraftSaveGuard`, the pillar's debounced autosave). The package publish publishes it with the other drafts. On a read-only base the view is customized instead: the save goes to the pair the ensure door answers, as a declared override (`overrideDraftBody`, ADR-0146 D2), the same door the Interfaces pillar's list views use. The existing form-view shape holds everything the designer writes (`sections[].name/label/columns/fields`), so no key was added.
  3. When New and Edit open different views (an `OBJECT.create` view beside the default), a plain 新建 / 编辑 switch appears in the toolbar. Switching flushes or confirms a pending edit first.
- **Toolbar chip.** "表单视图:ID" or "字段分组" names the layout being edited.
- **Fields not on the form.** In form-view mode a field listed in no section is not on the form, so the designer's spare bucket is "不在表单上". Dragging a field out of it adds the field as `{field}`. `writeFormSectionLayout` keeps each field entry's own keys (`required`, `readonly`, …), each section's other keys, and entries the canvas does not draw. A section that references a field group (`group`) stays a reference until its members change, and is then written out with its fields.
- **Preview.** The Form tab's Preview lays the form out by the same chosen view (`resolveFormViewLayout`: its sections and the tabbed layout), as the app's dialog does.
- **Header comment** of `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` rewritten to say what is now true.
- `recordFormNavigation.ts`: `FormViewDefinition` declares the optional `name` the metadata merge already stamps on it.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: en/zh strings for the chip, the switch and the bucket.
- One root changeset, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

Size: 10 files, +1,260 / −40.

## Tests

- `formViewSections-30057.test.ts` (9 tests): the choice for no view, a default view, and a create view plus default (flows differ), and the stubbed-resolver pin; `writeFormSectionLayout` keeping entry and section keys and undrawn entries; a field placed in no section leaves the form; a `group` section kept, then written out; the add, rename, move and remove helpers; record-shaped vs flat view items.
- `DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057.test.tsx` (5 tests, mounted Data pillar over a mock client):
  - with a default view, "Add group" PUTs a `view` draft whose sections are the view's plus the new one, and no object PUT;
  - CONTROL: with no form view the same action writes `fieldGroups` on the object draft;
  - a create view shows the 新建/编辑 switch and loads each view;
  - the Preview draws the view's sections;
  - on a read-only base the save goes to `com.qa.deals.custom` with `overrides {package, basedOn: '1.2.0'}`.
- **Ablation 1** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, designer forced back to `fieldGroups` unconditionally, `const formSections = formView?.sections ?? null` → `null`): 4 failed, 1 passed (the CONTROL), e.g. `expected ['Designer group'] to deeply equal ['Basic info','Money details']`. Restored blob == HEAD.
- **Ablation 2** (Preview before-reading, the `sections` spread removed): the Preview test goes red, and the Preview draws "Designer group" plus every field, Notes included.

## Acceptance notes

Browser runs on `examples/app-crm` (`--fresh`, Vite console on this branch's src, zh-CN, admin). Screenshots are in `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/30057-shots/`.

- **Case 1, no form view** (`case1-*`): moved 金额 into 设计器分组 and published. 新建 and 编辑 both read "设计器分组 | 名称 | 金额 | 阶段…". The chip reads 字段分组.
- **Case 2, default form view** (`case2-*`):
  - Baseline: published `fv_deal.form` (isDefault, sections 基本信息 / 金额信息). The app shows those sections.
  - Before, on main code (`case2-before-designer.png`, `case2-before-preview.png`): the designer showed 设计器分组 / 未分组. The Preview read "设计器分组 | 名称 | 金额 | 阶段 | 预计成交 | 备注", which is not what the app opens.
  - After (`case2-after-designer.png`, `case2-after-preview.png`): the chip reads 表单视图:fv_deal.form, with the view's sections plus 不在表单上 (负责人, 备注). The Preview reads "基本信息 | 名称* | 金额 | 金额信息 | 阶段 | 预计成交".
  - Moved 备注 into 金额信息. The view draft kept `required: true` on 名称, and the object's `fieldGroups` were untouched. After publishing, 新建 and 编辑 both show 备注 under 金额信息 (`case2-after-app-*.png`).
- **Case 3, read-only base** (`crm_lead`, `case3-*`):
  - Before, on main code: the designer showed "未分组 14 个字段" and the Preview was flat.
  - After: the chip reads 表单视图:crm_lead.form, with sections 线索信息 / 资格审查 / 转化 / 备注.
  - Moved 备注 into 转化. The draft was saved to `com.example.crm.custom` with `overrides {package: 'com.example.crm', basedOn: '4.0.0'}`.
  - After publishing, the served view's 转化 section holds 3 fields. The app's 新建 and 编辑 show 备注 inside 转化 (`case3-after-app-*.png`).
- **Flow switch** (`flow-switch-new.png`, `flow-switch-edit.png`): with `fv_deal.create` added, the chip reads 表单视图:fv_deal.create under 新建 and fv_deal.form under 编辑.
- Observed limits, not changed here:
  - the designer card does not show a form-view entry's `required` star;
  - a field newly added from the designer while in form-view mode lands in 不在表单上;
  - deleting a section moves its fields off the form;
  - an emptied section is kept in the view, and the app hides it;
  - the section settings inspector is off in form-view mode.
- Run note: during the case 2 before-shot, Vite served main code past its restore and saved one object draft reordering `notes`. That draft was published along with case 2. It was harmless on this throwaway `--fresh` boot.

- app-shell and i18n type-check: VERDICT 0.
- Wide ui vitest (studio-design/, app-shell `__tests__`, utils, i18n, the components censuses, the plugin-form write census): 497 files passed, 1 skipped; 5,095 tests passed, 21 skipped. VERDICT 0.
